name: DC441392
summary: DC441392 is the Exeter, UK chapter of the DEF CON Groups network, run by local volunteer Liam, meeting in person on the first Monday of the month at a pub called The Ship. The Discord is a small companion channel for coordinating those meetups and sharing knowledge on defensive and ethical hacking topics; it suits people in or near Exeter who want a local, in-person security community rather than a large online server.
